title: 删除链表的倒数第 N 个结点
statement:
给定链表的头节点 head 和整数 n，删除链表的倒数第 n 个节点（n = 1 表示最后一个节点），返回删除后链表的头节点。

节点定义：struct ListNode { int val; ListNode* next; };
constraints: 1 ≤ 节点数 sz ≤ 30；0 ≤ 节点值 ≤ 100；1 ≤ n ≤ sz

complexity.officialRequirement: 官方 follow-up 要求只遍历一趟完成（未额外要求空间）。
complexity.notes: sz 为节点数，输入链表不计入额外空间。哑节点 + 快慢指针：快指针先走 n 步，再同步前进至表尾，慢指针的下一个节点即待删节点。先求长度再删除的两趟做法同样能通过本地测试。最大测试为官方上限 sz = 30。

en.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
en.statement:
Given the head of a linked list and an integer n, remove the n-th node from the end of the list (n = 1 means the last node) and return the head of the resulting list.

Node definition: struct ListNode { int val; ListNode* next; };
constraints: 1 ≤ number of nodes sz ≤ 30; 0 ≤ node value ≤ 100; 1 ≤ n ≤ sz

complexity.officialRequirement: Official follow-up asks for doing it in a single pass (no additional space requirement).
complexity.notes: sz is the number of nodes; the input list does not count toward extra space. Dummy node + fast/slow pointers: the fast pointer first advances n steps, then both advance together until the end, and the node after the slow pointer is the one to delete. The two-pass approach (compute the length, then delete) also passes the local tests. The largest test uses the official limit sz = 30.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is the number of nodes sz; line 2 has sz integers, the list values; line 3 is n. stdout: one line with the values of the resulting list, separated by spaces; output an empty line if the result is empty.

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行节点数 sz；第二行 sz 个整数表示链表值；第三行 n。stdout：一行，删除后链表的值，以空格分隔；结果为空时输出空行。
